images/000000478717.jpg: A book seems a funny place for a parrot to perch; that scarlet belly jumps out against the chair.
images/000000137788.jpg: Bottles fill the shelves, and the dog has found just enough room underneath for a very cute nap spot.
images/000000020371.jpg: There’s nothing behind that pigeon but a blur of green. I like how its toes hook over the gutter lip.
images/000000231022.jpg: One green eye catches the light; the rest of the cat’s face barely emerges from shadow. It’s a striking portrait.
images/000000068293.jpg: What a jewel of a bird: a tiny patch of ruby under the bill sets off the green crown.
images/000000196355.jpg: The dark horse and the white one stand like bookends for a formal black-and-white portrait.
images/000000480205.jpg: The heron’s fine neck curves above a tangle of grass; that graceful shape is what I notice first.
images/000000066652.jpg: Those legs are tucked so far down that the giraffe looks almost all neck, which makes me smile.
images/000000516328.jpg: The crane looks positively drab beside its unlikely neighbor, a hydrant painted canary yellow and blue.
images/000000177529.jpg: I love how the orange kitten stretches off its stool just far enough to sniff the big dog’s nose.
images/000000557329.jpg: I find the picture hard to enjoy: crossing leaves swallow up the outline of the little perched bird.
images/000000132760.jpg: My eye keeps leaving the pony for the people behind the rail; the ring feels busy even out on the grass.
images/000000221542.jpg: Those long toes and the stare beneath that shaggy brow give the bird a slightly menacing air.
images/000000493438.jpg: The little zebra folded up at the other one’s feet makes this patch of shade feel especially peaceful.
images/000000438107.jpg: I’m amused by the two orange beaks pointing down at different angles, one huge and one tucked behind it.
images/000000022894.jpg: I love that white stripe between the puppy’s eyes; the floppy ears frame such a sweet, quiet face.
